entry.title_zh: 元吸引子与选择条件的重建
entry.title_en: Meta-attractors and reproduction of selection conditions
entry.claim_zh: 活动后果参与重建选择该组织的条件，使其经具体承载者变化仍能接续；区分机制条件、实际边界、动力学接近及可行纠正。
entry.claim_en: Consequences help reproduce conditions selecting an organization across carrier changes; distinguish mechanism conditions, formed boundaries, dynamical approach and feasible correction.
entry.scope_zh: 条件构造有47项新 Lean 定理／65项声明审计，直接连接实际核心轨迹、承载者替换、供给失败、盆地、扰动及区间／延迟下的退出。另有1,681项市场及1,053项回返预算计算。相同被动轨迹不足以辨认回返来源；经验对应、更丰富承载者实现及真实干预仍开放。作者反审不冒充独立验收；目标继续。
entry.scope_en: 47 new Lean theorems / 65 audits connect actual core traces, carrier replacement, supply failure, basin, disturbances and exit under delay/interval uncertainty. 1,681 market and 1,053 recurrence-budget calculations supplement the proofs. Identical passive histories need not identify causal return; empirical correspondence, richer carrier realization and actual interventions remain open. Author counterreview is not independent acceptance; the goal continues.
